info.name: Bread Classic Merchant Buyers Transactions API

description.content:
Legacy "bread-classic" REST API for managing Bread Pay BNPL checkouts. The Merchant API helps manage completed transactions and carts (which can also be created directly in the browser via the Bread JavaScript SDK), and the Shipping API exposes carrier and tracking number information on the transaction. Hosted by Bread Financial Holdings (NYSE: BFH).
